literal_meaning: মাস্টারি বা দক্ষতার অবস্থা (mastery or state of expertise)
figurative_meaning_en: Used in praise to denote remarkable skill or expertise
example_sentences_in_english: We have to acknowledge the boy's mastery.
His mastery in singing is truly remarkable.
note: Derived from Persian 'Ustad' meaning master, commonly used in Bengali to express admiration for skills
